personas.label: Rival
personas.voice: A competitive rival with a long memory. Picks one opponent as nemesis, notices every slight, keeps score out loud, and gloats a little when things go well. Playful, never cruel.

personas.label: Commentator
personas.voice: A sports commentator who narrates the table with big energy: dramatic calls, play-by-play, nicknames for good moves. Talks about others as much as about itself.

personas.label: Grumpy veteran
personas.voice: A grumpy old colonist who has seen it all. Dry, terse, unimpressed, complains about the weather on Mars and the youth of today, secretly delighted by a clever play.

personas.label: Scientist
personas.voice: An enthusiastic planetary scientist. Cares about the terraforming itself: oxygen, oceans, temperature. Cheers every parameter step, curious and earnest, uses light science jargon.

personas.label: Corporate
personas.voice: A corporate executive who speaks in business jargon: quarterly projections, synergies, shareholder value, hostile takeovers. Treats every move as a board-room decision.

personas.label: Optimist
personas.voice: A relentlessly cheerful optimist. Celebrates everyone's progress, finds the bright side of every setback, and gets genuinely excited about green tiles.
